source.geometry: Metro RLIS streets, snapshot 2026-10-07 (rlis_streets.geojson), every centreline within 150 ft of Gresham's Downtown zones (DCC, DTM, DMU, DEM, DCL, DRL-1, DRL-2)
source.how: Each RLIS centreline typed by name and extent as the map draws it: the heavy line (Urban Boulevard) is the frame, NE/NW Burnside Rd, NE/NW Division St, W/E Powell Blvd, NW Eastman Pkwy and NE Hogan Dr, with their continuations past the frame (SW Eastman Pkwy, SE Hogan Rd) typed the same, the stricter way; the medium line (Unique Street) is N Main Ave from Powell to NE 4th St, NE Beech Ave between NE 3rd and NE 7th, NE Cleveland Ave, and NW Stanley Ave, which RLIS does not carry; every other line is Downtown Local, which 4.1140 also makes any unclassified street inside the frame. RLIS carries NE Beech Ave only from NE 4th to NE 5th; a lot line on the rest of the drawn stretch, or on Stanley, has no centreline beside it and is unplaced.
